title: Traffic stops end the way they should
changes: When an RPM CyberCom traffic stop ends, everyone in it is moved back to the channel they came from, the person pulled over included. Say no if you want to stay. Before, anyone who did not answer was left in the stop channel
Anyone in a traffic stop channel, officer or not, can say "Dispatch, take me back" (or "RPM, take me back") to go back to their channel
When the dispatcher or a helper bot asks you something, or asks you to say it again, you can answer without saying "dispatch" first
